description: Unit tests for the AddressList class in the net namespace, testing creation, DNS alias handling, deduplication, and canonical name setting.

classes.name: AddressList
classes.description: A class representing a list of network addresses with DNS aliases and canonical name handling.

classes.name: IPEndPoint
classes.description: A class representing an IP address and port combination.

classes.name: IPAddress
classes.description: A class representing an IP address, supporting IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: CreateFromAddrinfo
methods.description: Creates an AddressList from a linked list of addrinfo structures.

methods.name: CreateFromIPAddressList
methods.description: Creates an AddressList from a list of IPAddress objects and DNS aliases.

methods.name: dns_aliases
methods.description: Returns the list of DNS aliases associated with the address list.

methods.name: SetDefaultCanonicalName
methods.description: Sets the default canonical name based on the IP address.

methods.name: SetDnsAliases
methods.description: Replaces the current DNS aliases with a new list.

methods.name: AppendDnsAliases
methods.description: Appends additional DNS aliases to the existing list.

methods.name: Deduplicate
methods.description: Removes duplicate addresses from the list while preserving order.
